# Welcome to ECO 230

This is the supplementary website for ECO 230. It provides lecture slides,
section-specific syllabi, dataset descriptions, and supporting course materials.
Use the navigation bar to find available resources.

[Canvas](https://www.uwlax.edu/canvas) is the primary course webpage. Go to your
Canvas course for weekly agendas, assignment instructions and due dates,
quizzes, submissions, grades, and announcements. When information differs,
follow the current instructions in Canvas.

## Inference examples

[Open the Inference Examples project in Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud/spaces/3173/content/13169695)
for the chi-square, t-test, Wilcoxon, ANOVA, and regression examples.
